segments.text: The section manager of the 1st marketing division where the protagonist is assigned to.

It is rumored that she's the top candidate for the next department head, due to her numerous achievements within the operations department. She is a calm and collected perfectionist who seeks solutions that are both smart and efficient.
Known for disliking idiots, she doesn't go easy on reprimanding them, especially to those who repeat the same mistakes.

Because of that, their newly transferred Murakami naturally became a target for her. However, seeing Murakami not get discouraged with her scoldings and eventually fulfill his duties, she has started to acknowledge him little by little.
Translated from Official Site
主人公が配属されたマーケティング一課の課長。
営業部内で順調に実績を積んでおり、次の部長候補の筆頭とうわさされている。
何事も理知的かつ効率的に解決する事を望む沈着冷静で完璧主義。
「バカは嫌い」と公言しており、特に同じ失敗を繰り返す者には容赦のない叱責を浴びせる。
新しく配属されてきた新人――村上も当然ながらその対象。
しかし、叱責してもめげずに立ち向かって最終的に職務を果たす彼を見て、少しずつ認めるようになっていく。

A high spec employee who is fluent in five languages, graduated from a state university and has also studied abroad. She is the assistant manager of the 1st marketing division.
Smart and quick thinking, but is somewhat lacking in discretion, which is holding her back from being promoted.
While Kuge is troubled because of that, it has become a trivial matter considering her skills and achievements which are vital to the division.
Making good use of her language skills and quick thinking in particular, her presentation and communication skills are highly esteemed not only in her department but within the whole company.
Because of her wild, cheerful, and caring personality, she teases their newbie Murakami a bit, but also looks after him and tries to help him out in some way.
Translated from Official Site
国立大学出身で海外への留学経験もあり、5ヶ国語を使いこなすハイスペックな女性社員。
待遇としては、マーケティング一課の係長。
頭も良く機転も利くが、いささか慎重さに欠けるところがあり、それが災いして昇進に歯止めを掛けている。
そのことでよく久家の頭を悩ませてはいるが、それが瑣末な問題に思えるほど、彼女の能力とその成果は一課に必要なもの。
特に語学力と頭の回転の早さを活かしたプレゼンテーションとコミュニケーション能力は、部内どころか社内でも一目を置かれている。
奔放かつ明朗快活な性格の持ち主で面倒見が良いことから、新人の村上のミスを弄りつつ、何かにつけて彼の面倒を見ている。

A female employee who joined the 1st marketing division in the same year as the protagonist Murakami. While her title is senior staff, she also does secretarial duties to assist the busy Kuge and Takano.
At the same time, she keeps track of the schedule of the entire division and has become indispensable to the team, even though she has only been there for a short time.
Always beaming a kind smile on her face, she has a similarly soft demeanor and a gentle personality.
For that reason, she is worried about Murakami who is regularly reprimanded by Kuge. She always cheers him up whenever he's scolded and even helps him with his job, with Kuge being none the wiser.
Translated from Official Site
村上と同じく今年からマーケティング一課に配属された女性社員。
待遇としては主任であると共に、多忙な久家と高野の秘書的な役目を担っている。
それと共に一課全体のスケジュールを把握しており、配属されて間もない状況ながら、一課になくてはならない者の一人となっている。
常に優しげな笑みを浮かべるその容貌と同じく、物腰は柔らかく、穏やかでおっとりとした性格の持ち主。
そのためか日々久家に叱責される村上のことを気遣い、怒られるたびに彼を励まし、久家にナイショでその業務を手伝うことも少なくない。

The protagonist. A new employee who just graduated from a middle class university. He is passionate, impulsive, and daring, but it's exactly these traits of him that cause his efforts to go nowhere which makes him a bit unreliable.

Neither having the experience nor the academic background to be qualified for a major company, his enthusiasm was what sold him to HR, which then landed him a position at the 1st marketing division where newbies don't last long.

He never had a girlfriend in his life and is a virgin. Naturally, he's not used to women and didn't have much opportunities to be acquainted with one until now, and coupled with his straightforward thinking and narrow vision it made him extremely dense.
This might as well be the first time in his life being up close with women, and the moment he realized that he started being conscious of it.
Translated from Official Site
